# How Do I Manage Owner Payouts Automatically?


You manage owner payouts by calculating each net payout automatically from connected revenue, commission, and expenses, with clear reports generated for each owner. On **Jestor** , this connects reservation revenue, commission, and property expenses into one flow, integrated with **Omie** .


Manually calculating what each owner should receive, factoring in commission and variable expenses per property, is an administrative task prone to error at any meaningful scale.


## What manual payout calculation risks


- Calculation errors when combining revenue, commission, and expenses by hand
- No clear breakdown for the owner of what makes up their payout
- Delay between period close and the payout actually being processed
- Manual reconciliation needed between the calculation and what was actually paid


## How structured payout management works


- Reservation revenue, agreed commission, and expenses connect to the specific property
- Net payout can be calculated automatically from that connected data
- PDF reports can be generated automatically per owner, showing the breakdown
- Approved payouts enter **Omie** or **Conta Azul** as an accounts payable entry


## Why Jestor fits this use case


- Automatic calculation removes the risk of manual error in complex formulas
- Generated reports give each owner clear transparency into their payout
- Native ERP integration removes manual re-entry of the final payment
- Scales from a few owners to a large portfolio without redesign


Manual calculation Structured payout management


Error-prone, manual formulas Calculated automatically, connected data


## Frequently Asked Questions


**Does the payout calculation account for commission and expenses automatically?** Yes, provided this data is connected to the property record. More at[jestor.com](https://www.jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com) .


**Do owners receive a detailed payout report?** Yes, PDF reports can be generated automatically.


**Is the payout paid automatically by Jestor?** No, Jestor organizes the calculation and approval, the ERP or bank executes payment.
